scope: Actual public-web modules compiled with synthetic Auth/database, media and Next navigation adapters. No real-provider, hosted authentication or physical-device acceptance.

checks.name: Actual Home feed renders with its primary destinations and consistent outline icons
Global keyboard search opens the encoded destination
Create disclosure supports Escape and returns keyboard focus
Create Post opens the actual composer and Cancel retains its caption
Composer keeps keyboard focus inside and supports Review then Edit without resetting
Desktop feed media uses the available card width after closing the composer
Account menu changes appearance and the composer remains readable in Dim
Settings search finds relevant destinations and offers a clear no-results exit
Media preference switches are named, persist, and explain data-saver precedence
A failed initial account check retries without a page reload or premature profile writes
Edit profile opens the actual owner-bound editor
A failed profile save retains the draft, and retry confirms exactly one owner
Unsaved profile changes block an unrelated search when discard is declined
Cancel offers a reviewable discard and returns to the owner profile
Owner profile has working edit, private collection and draft destinations
Invalid profile links and disguised image bytes stop before any write or upload
Profile photo selection previews locally and Cancel makes no Storage write
Browser Back preserves the owner draft and photo for explicit restoration on return
Photo save retry reuses the verified owner path and keeps both local previews intact
Repeated submit is deduplicated and a late save cannot overwrite a switched account
Visitor profile surfaces conversation failure and recovers without duplicate actions
Messages opens the actual conversation with profile, shared-media, details and exit actions
Inbox table and unread RPC requests pin the current account and support cancellation
Closing and reopening a conversation preserves its unsent draft
New message has a keyboard exit and makes no conversation or message write on Cancel
Recipient search and conversation failures retain review context and retry without sending a message
Mobile messages keep search, requests, compose actions and Back reachable without losing the draft
Communities search has a real clear-search exit and connected channel navigation
Community creation contains focus, keeps a cancelled draft and preserves it on failure
Community detail opens members and returns focus to its actual member control
Community settings preview files locally and Cancel does not update Storage or community settings
Community settings preserve an uncertain save and retry the same uploaded photo path
Community layout and create dialog fit a narrow screen with all actions reachable
Channel creation keeps its draft through Escape and reaches the confirmed channel
Channel settings protect unsaved edits and reject a failed save without closing
Offline and restored notices preserve the current composer caption without reloading
Mobile all-destinations menu fits and contains every major journey
320px viewport keeps the brand, top actions and post controls inside the viewport
Failed sign-out remains visible and never reports a signed-out route
Warm Home and Messages retain loaded content, scroll and drafts on every sampled frame during held refreshes
